panels.description: Grid connection/protector state, NOT utility-only availability. Events count observed 1→0 transitions on a nominal 5s cluster/10s gateway observation grid; initial already-disconnected state is not an onset. Gaps can conceal transitions/extrema. Connected percentage uses raw observed states, not elapsed uptime. Heartbeat coverage is received diagnostics / nominal expected samples; complete expected-sample coverage counts successful polls against nominal expected samples. Neither reconstructs missing time. Voltage/frequency quality uses connected samples; minute counts are sampled observations, not exact durations. Historical aggregation uses raw retained measurements. Complete expected-sample coverage is reported separately and is absent—not zero—before poll diagnostics existed; partial coverage limits confidence without erasing the aggregate.

panels.title: Observed Power Peaks

panels.description: Age uses producer wallclock captured BEFORE device read attempts, not Prometheus scrape timestamps. Fast data requires age −5≤age<30s (5s poll/10s local scrape); materially future clocks fail closed. Latest complete flag is a poll result, not current freshness: interpret with age. Settings uses last observations ≤10m and requires producer age<600s for display elsewhere. Missing diagnostics means unknown/collector upgrade required, not zero age. Exec kills/crashes are caught by age even when no failure status was emitted.
panels.title: Solar Poll Health

panels.description: One discrete bar per completed inverter device day for direct inverter-maintained kWh counters. Observed reset samples occur at 19:01:35–19:01:50 UTC (00:01:35–00:01:50 Asia/Karachi). At each UTC-midnight bar timestamp, max_over_time reads the reset-safe 19:02 UTC through 19:01 UTC window and represents the immediately preceding Asia/Karachi device day. Load is directly measured; PV production, grid import, battery discharge and battery charge are gross source flows, not load allocation, and must not be summed. The current partial device day remains in panel 17. Missing samples remain gaps; a bar can still be computed from partial observations, so the separate Poll coverage (diagnostics era) line reports complete expected-sample coverage. Coverage is absent—not zero—before poll diagnostics existed. A genuine all-zero day remains zero; max protects against an isolated false zero but not a false high sample. Bars are non-stacked overlays for Grafana 10.2.8 compatibility. The panel requests 30 days for relative ranges; an explicitly selected absolute dashboard range wins.
